tagline: Find gate 13 before the final boarding call.

listing.short: Walk an empty airport, search abandoned bags and satisfy a protocol-obsessed officer to reach gate 13 before the final boarding call.
listing.long:
You land as the only passenger in an airport that still runs every procedure. Search the bags in the baggage hall, put your keys in the tray, show your passport and buy something at duty free while the intercom counts down your last chance to board.

It is a short, one-time horror story you play in your browser. At gate 13 eight copies of you are waiting in line: point out the one that is exactly you.

quote_cards.line:
Thank you for staying with us.
Forever.

The tray. Then the detector.
Then we talk.

shotlist_tips: Record in the Decentraland desktop Explorer at 1920x1080 or higher; hide the UI where you can and keep the cursor out of the frame.
Play with sound on and record system audio: the hum and the chime before every intercom line carry the clips.
Scares fire once per visit. Reload the World between takes so they happen again.
For vertical reels, frame the subject in the middle third of a 16:9 recording so a 9:16 crop keeps it.
Keep the ending (the right pick and the final card) out of public clips.

posts.title: Footage: did you see it
posts.footage: From the north end of the corridor, walk toward the baggage-hall doorway. The figure crosses the lit doorway and is gone. Cut immediately after it passes. 6 to 8 seconds. Best as a vertical reel; also loops well.

posts.title: Quote: the tray
posts.text:
"The tray. Then the detector. Then we talk."

The only person left in the airport is very good at his job.

posts.title: Behind the scenes: bureaucracy horror
posts.text:
The scariest thing in EEIREPORT is a queue.

Three checkpoints in a zig-zag. Metal in the tray or the detector rings. Leave the hall and the line resets. The officer says nothing that is not in the manual.

Horror comedy by bureaucracy.
